game_title: Compound Combo – Cinder Cone Camp Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Compound Combo: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: In Cinder Cone Camp, repeat each round: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the energy value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the cooling vent using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The cooling vent reached with actions_used <= 12.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the cooling vent is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Compound Combo
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
